verdict.rationale: Snyk Studio provides an official local MCP server and hooks-based integration for agentic dev environments (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot) so AI-generated code is scanned via natural-language prompts or hooks before landing, plus CLI slash-commands like /snyk-fix for in-agent remediation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the Studio MCP workflow in production, and detail on automatic pre-commit enforcement (vs. manual prompting).
